observations: Full-size electronic keyboard wrapped in clear plastic film.
Silver/grey chassis with standard black and white keys.
Left-side control panel with buttons, a rotary knob, and a small rectangular display.
Speaker grilles visible on the left side.
Watermark text "MARY OLUGBAMI POSTION LTD" across the lower center.
No readable brand logo or model number in either photo.
Two near-identical photos showing the same wrapped keyboard standing on a tiled floor.

claims.evidence: Build quality cannot be assessed from wrapped still photos.
Origin and prior-use history cannot be verified from photos.
Sound output cannot be heard from still photos.

risks.risk: Keyboard may not power on at all.
risks.proof: Video of the unit powering up and producing sound.

risks.risk: Some keys may be dead, sticky, or broken.
Display or control buttons may be faulty.
risks.proof: Video showing the display lit and buttons responding.

risks.risk: Speakers may be blown or silent.
risks.proof: Audio recording of sound coming from the speakers.

risks.risk: "London used" origin is unproven; it may be locally used.
risks.proof: Clear branding, import documents, or seller receipt showing origin.
risks.if_unproven: as locally used or unknown origin

proof_requests: Video of the keyboard powering on and being played.
Close-up photo of any brand badge or model label.
Audio clip of sound output from the speakers.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an electronic keyboard even though wrapped and unbranded in the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (not working) while proof is requested to raise the value.
